composition.coaching_note: Agent: 'Do you take any brand-name medications I should check?' This is a good question to ask, but it could be more specific. For example, 'Do you take any brand-name medications that you use regularly?'
composition.summary: The call was compliant with CMS rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered prior to discussing any benefits, and the Scope of Appointment was collected before the plan discussion. The appointment was scheduled 120 hours after the SOA was collected.
